observation_snapshot.note: Reproduces the frozen RESEARCH_CORPUS_AUTHORITY_V1 corpus exactly (20,384 rows / 216 events). Live table has since grown (>=20,428 rows / 217 events).

settlement_source: research_model_ready_rows.settlement_label = canonical_row.labelAsOf, produced by scripts/modeling/materialize-research-model-ready.ts from lib/modeling/research-corpus/rollingCorpus.ts (asOfLabel) over per-partition rows whose label is deriveLabel() in lib/modeling/forward-rich/materializeForwardRichResearch.ts; underlying terminal truth = Gamma terminal event state (RESEARCH_CORPUS_CONTRACT.md 5.2), persisted before this mission. generated_signal_pairs.signal_result is NOT used.
latest_authority_rule: Per exact (provider_event_id, condition_id, selected_token_id): any persisted WIN/LOSS/VOID row is terminal and sticky (asOfLabel + MONOTONIC_SETTLEMENT_GUARD_V1: terminal never regresses to OPEN); otherwise OPEN. Terminal ties resolve by (model_date, decision_at, created_at) desc; no token has conflicting terminal labels (0), so the result is order-independent. Condition status is derived from token states: UNIQUE_WINNER (exactly 1 distinct WIN token, 0 conflicts), VOID (explicit only), AMBIGUOUS (>1 WIN token or WIN/LOSS conflict), LOSS_ONLY (terminal LOSS token(s) but no persisted winner), OPEN.

observed_identity_coverage.identity_key: physical_event_id + provider_event_id + condition_id + token_id + canonical_market_type (DISTINCT; T30/T10/T3/LIVE_GUARD rows collapsed)

event_level.terminal_labelable_event_definition: event with >=1 terminal-labelled identity; open = no terminal identity but >=1 OPEN; unresolved = all identities unresolved. No event has all identities terminal.

market_family_coverage.reconciliation: identities 1188+3546+3940+272+776 = 9722; terminal identities 74+131+301+0+8 = 514; per-family events: terminal+open+unresolved equals observed_event_n in every family (events appear in several families, so event counts are not summed)

no_bet_coverage.actual_execution_definition: bet_execution_ledger row with exchange_order_id and status FILLED/WON/LOST, joined by exact (condition_id, token_id) -> event_execution_queue.reservation_id -> night_event_reservations.physical_event_id

executed_consistency.not_comparable_breakdown: 27 settled - 9 comparable = 18: 5 LOSS_ONLY conditions (no persisted winner), 2 OPEN conditions (model_ready lags ledger), 11 conditions absent from model_ready

basis: Observed identities are enumerated from reservation_market_observations alone; research_model_ready_rows is LEFT-joined afterwards and only supplies the label (label count 9722 == identity count 9722; no identity dropped, OPEN/UNRESOLVED retained in the denominator).
No label field is read by any selection, eligibility, phase or timing predicate; selection fields (live_policy_eligibility, observation_phase, observed_at, strategy SELECTED) are untouched.
Terminal labels never change a historical candidate row (the label layer is separate from immutable decision-time features, RESEARCH_CORPUS_CONTRACT.md 5.1).
Executed bets are used only as an independent witness, never as the source of shadow labels.
temporal_safety.required_downstream_sequence: SELECTION_BEFORE_SETTLEMENT_V1: decision-time candidate -> decision-time-only filter -> join label afterwards -> OPEN stays in sample accounting

known_limitations: Coverage is low: 514 of 9,722 observed identities (5.29%) are terminal-labelable; 8,708 identities sit in conditions that research_model_ready_rows never materialized (its model_date range ends 2026-10-07 and it is a legacy signal-population space, not the observation corpus). This is a data limitation, not an authority failure.
Event-level coverage (152/216 events) counts events with at least one labelled identity; no event is fully labelled. Economics must be computed per labelled identity, not per event.

OPEN means 'latest persisted state is non-terminal', not 'proven unsettled': model_ready lags the ledger (both executed bets whose condition is OPEN in model_ready are already settled in the ledger: 1 WON, 1 LOST). OPEN is therefore an upper bound on genuinely open.

64 LOSS labels rest on the exact token's own persisted terminal LOSS in conditions with no persisted winner (LOSS_ONLY); the other 64 observed identities in those LOSS_ONLY conditions remain UNRESOLVED. Drop those 64 for a strict winner-only reading (LOSS 225, terminal 450).
142 identities (LIVE_GUARD, null provider_event_id / 3 sport-unresolved events) cannot be keyed; 34,555 model_ready rows have null provider_event_id and are unusable.

964 model_ready tokens have an earlier terminal row followed by a later OPEN row (terminal regression); sticky-terminal rule applied; none of them touches the observed corpus, so literal latest-wins would give identical results here.
Executed cross-check is 9 comparable conditions of 27 settled; 0 mismatch is strong but small-sample.
No VOID is persisted anywhere in research_model_ready_rows; VOID_IDENTITY_N=0 is absence of evidence, not proof that no voids occurred.
SPREAD remains SETTLEMENT_ANALYTICALLY_QUARANTINED; this mission did not lift it. TOTAL_CORNERS remains SOURCE_SAMPLE_ABSENT.

generated_signal_pairs.signal_result (non-authoritative per contract 5.2) adds 0 labels for unresolved identities, so no secondary persisted source closes the gap; only new settlement ingestion would.
